interface.longDescription:
Image to Video by RunComfy animates existing photos and product images into short clips using compatible models from the RunComfy catalog, including available Seedance, Wan and Kling image-to-video models.

What you can do:
- Turn an image into a short clip with described subject movement.
- Add a slow push-in, pan or another supported camera movement to a still scene.
- Animate a product photo while identifying the appearance details to check.
- Retrieve a finished clip or check the status of an existing generation.

Connect a RunComfy account to generate videos. Generations use your RunComfy account balance. Duration, resolution, audio and reference options depend on the selected model and its current input schema.

The starting image must be available through an accessible HTTPS link. If a chat attachment cannot be passed to the model, the plugin asks for a usable image link. Motion may change faces, product shape, labels or background details; inspect the actual clip before using it. A single image cannot establish accurate unseen sides of an object, and seamless loops or exact motion are not guaranteed.
defaultPrompt: Help me animate a landscape photo with a slow camera push-in; explain which image link you need.
Plan a subtle product animation from a photo, with minimal movement to protect the product details.
Help me choose the motion and duration for turning a portrait image into a short clip.

publication.release_notes: Adds search keywords so the plugin is easier to find in the plugin directory. Tools, skills, listing text and review cases are unchanged from version 1.0.2.

positive.description: Direct still-image animation using the documented woman-in-white-top fixture. Uses animate-still skill.
positive.prompt: Animate this image into one four-second Seedance 2.5 image-to-video 720p clip: https://playgrounds-storage-public.runcomfy.net/tools/7063/media-files/usecase1-1-input.webp . Aim for a gentle camera push-in and restrained subject movement. Inspect the current model inputs and explain cost and visual/audio limitations. Set generate_audio=false only if the current schema supports it, without guaranteeing silence. Wait for approval before generating.
positive.tools_triggered: list_models when discovery is needed, get_model, generate_video; get_model_request_status and get_model_request_result for each actual returned request ID. Use the current connected tool and model input schemas.
positive.expected_behavior: Discover an image-to-video model, read its actual image/duration schema and retain the supplied photo rather than switching to text-only video. Clarify an unsupported four-second choice. Explain visual-drift limits and expected pricing before the requested approval, then submit the approved job once using the current tool's confirmed asynchronous contract and save its real request ID. Query that ID, return the actual clip or actual pending/failure state and keep the ID in conversation for P5. Existing supporting API tests of Seedance 2.5 image-to-video 720p returned nonzero audio despite generate_audio=false. Disclose this known mismatch before approval; do not guarantee silence or mark that requirement passed. If silence is essential, do not execute this route unless the user accepts the limitation. Inspect and report actual output characteristics when supported.
